title: Sovereignty and jurisdiction risk needs an approved sponsor assessment
remediation: The sponsor business owner and designated security, privacy and legal authorities define the assessed business functions, data and jurisdictions. Assess potential injury from external legal compulsion, document jurisdiction-specific threats and vulnerabilities, and update categorization where supported. Retain reviewed risk and treatment decisions for each relevant jurisdiction. Use G111 for separate processing and storage location evidence.

milestones.title: Collect the scoped injury, threat, vulnerability and jurisdiction risk assessments, plus the signed treatment and categorization decision
